_comment: Backend (agent CLI) pins for BrainMark. This file is OWNED BY THE AGENTS LAYER and is deliberately separate from ../config.json: config.json pins the experiment, backends.json pins the machine that runs it. Both are hashed into run metadata.
_default_backend_note: Plan 0.5: the codex/Azure adapter is PRIMARY. The claude adapter stays in-tree, is exercised by the stub tests, and is NOT used for v1 confirmatory runs. Backends are never pooled in a report -- the backend is a reported factor, per devenv memory 'cross-cell comparison is confounded'.

prices._price_provenance: The Azure deployments gpt-5 / gpt-5.6-sol / gpt-5.6-terra are internal deployment names with no public rate card available to this harness. The numbers below are PLACEHOLDERS so that a usd figure exists for the resume guard and the cost column; every packet/report that prints a codex usd MUST also print price_status. Replace with the tenant's real rate card before any cost claim is published. Claude rows are copied from ../pricing.json (agent-brain's frozen table) and are real.
prices._convention_note: Codex/OpenAI report cached_input_tokens as a SUBSET of input_tokens; Anthropic reports cache_read/cache_creation DISJOINT from input_tokens. compute_usd() in base.py implements both conventions explicitly -- see its docstring.
